derivation: Pause points form a ladder: the script asks again each time price falls a further 5.5% below the last time it asked, while at least 8% under the running peak. A new high resets the ladder. optimal_action is computed from what the series did afterwards, never hand-picked; moments with fewer than 20 trading days remaining are marked ambiguous.
